commits.author: Subhrodip Mohanta
commits.message:
Remove CircleCI configuration, unused dependencies, and redundant annotations

- Deleted `.circle/config.yml` to fully migrate from CircleCI.
- Removed unused `spring-boot-starter-jdbc` dependency from `pom.xml`.
- Eliminated redundant `@Service` annotation in `UserService` interface.

commits.author: Subhrodip Mohanta
commits.message: Update CI badge link in README for better visibility and accuracy

commits.author: Subhrodip Mohanta
commits.message:
Upgrade MySQL Connector and Testcontainers versions in `pom.xml`

- Updated `mysql-connector.version` to 9.1.0 for improved compatibility and features.
- Updated `testcontainers.version` to 1.20.6 for latest fixes and enhancements.

commits.author: Subhrodip Mohanta
commits.message:
Upgrade Spring Boot version and enhance CI workflows

- Updated Spring Boot version in `pom.xml` to 3.4.4 for latest features and compatibility.
- Refactored GitHub Actions workflows:
  - Renamed `build` job to `build-jar` and added artifact upload step.
  - Introduced `build-and-push-images` job with dependency on `build-jar`.
  - Improved container registry login and image deployment process for DockerHub and GitHub Container Registry.

commits.author: Subhrodip Mohanta
commits.message:
Refactor Dockerfile, workflows, and dependencies for optimization

- Migrated base images in Dockerfile to Amazon Corretto for better performance and support.
- Updated Maven build commands to skip tests during packaging for efficiency.
- Added OCI-compliant label for repository source in Dockerfile.
- Fixed MySQL Connector dependency group/artifact IDs in `pom.xml`.
- Improved GitHub Actions YAML indentation and consistency.
- Introduced SonarQube cache in GitHub workflows for better CI performance.

commits.author: Subhrodip Mohanta
commits.message:
Update README and workflows for improved setup clarity and Java 21 migration

- Enhanced README with detailed installation options and updated Docker Compose instructions.
- Replaced `docker-compose` with `docker compose` commands in README for consistency.
- Updated GitHub Actions workflows to use Java 21 (migrated from JDK 11) with Microsoft distribution.
- Removed redundant dependencies, database container setup, and cache configurations in workflows for streamlined CI.
- Ensured compatibility with the latest Docker CLI and project standardizations.

commits.author: Subhrodip Mohanta
commits.message:
Upgrade dependencies and improve testing suite

- Updated `pom.xml` with version properties for Spring Boot, MySQL Connector, Testcontainers, Liquibase Maven Plugin, and JaCoCo.
- Consolidated repetitive version definitions in dependencies to use placeholders.
- Added unit tests for `UserServiceImpl`, `TransactionServiceImpl`, `AdminServiceImpl`, and `AccountServiceImpl`.
- Enhanced `pom.xml` configuration with JaCoCo Maven Plugin for code coverage reporting.

commits.author: Subhrodip Mohanta
commits.message:
Migrate project to Java 21 and Jakarta EE

- Updated to Java 21 across the project (Dockerfile, Maven workflows, and POM).
- Replaced `javax.persistence` imports with `jakarta.persistence`.
- Upgraded Hibernate dialect to `MySQLDialect` in `application.properties`.
- Refactored `SecurityConfig` to remove `WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter` in favor of modern `SecurityFilterChain`.
- Simplified `UserServiceImpl` account creation logic, removing dependencies on `AccountService`.
- Streamlined `HomeController` by removing deprecated error handling methods.
- Updated Testcontainers dependencies to latest versions.
- Revised MySQL connector dependency version for improved compatibility.

commits.author: Subhrodip Mohanta
commits.message:
Update GitHub Actions and Workflow Configuration

- Upgraded actions to the latest versions (e.g., `actions/checkout@v4`, `actions/setup-java@v4`, `actions/cache@v4`, `docker/build-push-action@v5`).
- Introduced Docker Buildx and improved DockerHub login setup.
- Enhanced environment configuration using GitHub secrets for database credentials.
- Added new ENV variable `SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=prod` in `Dockerfile`.
- Commented out unused database connection properties in `application.properties`.

commits.author: Subhrodip Mohanta
commits.message:
Vibe with Gemini
Add Docker Compose support for development, production & testing setup

- Created `docker-compose.dev.yml` and `docker-compose.prod.yml` for local and production environments.
- Added a standard `docker-compose.yml` for general setup.
- Updated `Dockerfile` to include multi-stage build for optimized container image.
- Integrated Liquibase for database migrations with MySQL in both environments.
- Enhanced testing with Testcontainers included in `ApplicationTests`.
- Expanded README.md to provide thorough setup, usage, and contribution guidelines.
